articles.title: E20 petrol can reduce India's dependence on imports: ONGC official
articles.summary: ONGC Director Om Prakash Sinha stated E20 petrol can significantly boost India's self-reliance and reduce fuel imports. Speaking at an event, Sinha emphasized E20's critical role in enhancing national energy security. This push for ethanol-blended petrol is a crucial stride for India to decrease its reliance on foreign oil, aligning with broader national goals for economic and resource independence.

articles.title: NASA lays out phased plan to return Starliner to service
articles.summary: NASA and Boeing have outlined a roadmap to return the Starliner spacecraft to operational service, overcoming significant technical hurdles from past flights. This plan ensures Starliner’s readiness for future crewed missions, particularly to the International Space Station. This development is vital for advancing commercial human spaceflight capabilities, showcasing crucial progress in space technology and manned spaceflight engineering.

articles.title: The Shadows Have Other Ideas (9 Photos)
articles.summary: This article delves into captivating optical illusions crafted by shadows and mundane objects. It illustrates how a painted witch on the road creatively transforms a traffic cone into her hat, playing tricks on visual perception. The text explores various shadow interactions, such as figures seemingly detaching from their silhouettes, highlighting the fascinating interplay between light, shadow, and our interpretation of reality.

articles.title: ‘The Love Hypothesis’ Cast Guide: Who’s Who in the New Prime Video Romance?
articles.summary: The article discusses "The Love Hypothesis," a new Prime Video release that uniquely explores romantic relationships by literally applying scientific chemistry to the concept of love. This fictional narrative delves into complex romantic dynamics as if a scientific hypothesis. The review includes light spoilers for viewers interested in its distinctive approach to interpreting love through a scientific lens.
